outfits.name: Campus Casual
outfits.prompt: Base (swimwear): A bright orange-and-gold tropical-print triangle bikini top with string ties at the neck and back, paired with matching side-tie bikini bottoms in the same warm sunset palette. An open white linen button-up shirt worn unbuttoned and loose over the bikini, sleeves rolled to the elbows. Layered gold pendant necklaces resting against the collarbone, chunky gold hoop earrings, and a small gold nose stud. Barefoot with a woven raffia beach tote slung over one shoulder and a stack of thin gold bangles on the left wrist., Campus Casual: A cropped mustard-yellow ribbed knit tank top cut above the navel, tucked into high-waisted caramel-brown wide-leg linen trousers that drape long and pool slightly over chunky white platform sneakers. A faded mid-wash denim jacket cropped at the natural waist, worn open over the tank with sleeves pushed up to the forearms. Layered gold pendant necklaces at varying lengths, and a small gold nose stud. A woven crossbody bag strap cutting diagonally across the chest, and a stack of mismatched gold rings across both hands.

outfits.name: Pier Double-Date
outfits.prompt: Base (swimwear), A neon coral and gold geometric-patterned triangle bikini top with string ties knotted at the neck and back, worn beneath a semi-sheer white linen button-up shirt left open and unbuttoned, the sleeves rolled to the elbows. Distressed denim cutoff shorts in a mid-blue wash, fraying naturally at the hem, sitting high on the waist with rolled cuffs. Strappy tan leather sandals with thin ankle-wrap ties. Layered gold pendant necklaces — one delicate chain with a small cowrie shell charm, one longer rope chain — plus chunky oversized gold hoop earrings and a pair of thin gold bangles on the right wrist., Pier Double-Date, A deep emerald-green silk wrap blouse with a crossover V-neckline and three-quarter sleeves that cinch neatly at the cuff, the fabric falling in soft controlled folds across the torso. Tailored cream-coloured high-waisted wide-leg trousers in a crisp cotton-linen blend, breaking cleanly at the ankle over pointed-toe burgundy leather block-heel ankle boots with a short stacked heel. A structured tan leather mini shoulder bag worn crossbody on a slim strap. Layered gold necklaces — a short chain with a small coin pendant and a mid-length bezel-set bar pendant — paired with medium-sized gold hoop earrings, a slim gold watch on the left wrist, and two thin gold bangles on the right.
